description: Get the full public record for one provider by its Later Stages URL (from search_senior_care or list_providers). Nursing homes include Medicare ratings, fines and inspection citations from the last 3 years; assisted living homes include license details and where to find state inspection reports. Covers California only. Read-only public records; no prices, availability or reviews.

url.description: Provider page URL or path, e.g. https://laterstages.com/california/huntington-beach/huntington-terrace/

name: get_provider
title: Get one provider record
